verdict.rationale: React's own docs say React Native and Expo let developers build apps in React for Android and iOS with truly native UIs, and the GitHub README says React powers mobile apps via React Native. A community member praises its 'learn-once-write-anywhere' model for building high-quality platform-native apps; a 2015 note that Android support was still 'coming soon' is an early-era caveat, not a current contradiction. missing for 10: concrete evidence of mobile runtime performance, documentation of how much code (not just skills) carries over between web and native, current independent corroboration of iOS/Android parity.
